sentence: This project builds a complete family tree for a plant family and uses it to study how the plants adapted to extreme environments.
This project studies how summer research experiences in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity affect the way middle school teachers teach.
This project builds an associate degree program that combines energy grid operations with cybersecurity, using hands-on simulation.
This project studies how the many kinds of interactions among fish on coral reefs shape the way the whole ecosystem works and changes.
This project tries to find out why a short ethylene treatment of seedlings makes plants grow larger and handle stress better.
This project builds a library that lets reinforcement learning applications be set up automatically on data centers with several types of hardware devices.
This project studies whether lessons that use Geographic Information Systems in several school subjects build spatial reasoning in high schools.
This project designs ultra-low power circuits for artificial intelligence hardware using a 2D material with ferroelectric and semiconducting properties.
This project uses computations and machine learning to understand quantum defects, such as missing atoms, in two-dimensional materials.
This project builds machine learning tools that work out the structure of molecules from their gas phase spectroscopy.
This project uses High-Performance Computing to design algorithms and simulation models for problems in bioinformatics, computational chemistry and computer vision.
This project uses research and Indigenous ecological knowledge to find solutions to prairie ecosystem problems that communities have identified.
This project tries to find out why growth plate cartilage in long bones is replaced by bone, and how stem cells and estrogen affect this.
This project builds a low-cost, self-sustaining edge device that uses machine learning to monitor industrial equipment and diagnose machine problems.
This project investigates environmental interfaces that regulate environmental and ecosystem processes in urban systems.
This project studies whether brain white matter can predict math skills in children and how those skills change over a learning interruption.
